# Publishing: VK

See [the VK guide](../../publishing/vk.md) for how to get these values.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `publish.vk.api-base-url`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_API_BASE_URL`<br>`--publish-vk-api-base-url` | string | `https://api.vk.com` | VK API base URL; methods are called under /method/ |
| `publish.vk.api-version`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_API_VERSION`<br>`--publish-vk-api-version` | string | `5.199` | value of the mandatory VK API version parameter |
| `publish.vk.caption`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_CAPTION`<br>`--publish-vk-caption` | string | — | VK specific post text |
| `publish.vk.enabled`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_ENABLED`<br>`--publish-vk-enabled` | bool | — | publish to VK |
| `publish.vk.fit`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_FIT`<br>`--publish-vk-fit` | string | `none` | how the render is made to match vk's frame: none, cover, contain or stretch; anything but none needs width and height |
| `publish.vk.fit-background`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_FIT_BACKGROUND`<br>`--publish-vk-fit-background` | string | `#ffffff` | hex colour behind a contain letterbox for vk, and what transparency is flattened onto |
| `publish.vk.height`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_HEIGHT`<br>`--publish-vk-height` | int | — | render height for vk; 0 inherits render.height |
| `publish.vk.lead-video`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_LEAD_VIDEO`<br>`--publish-vk-lead-video` | string, path | — | not available: a vk post is pictures or a video and never both, so a value here is refused rather than ignored |
| `publish.vk.max-attachments`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_MAX_ATTACHMENTS`<br>`--publish-vk-max-attachments` | int | — | post at most this many pages to vk at once; 0 uses the platform's own limit, which is also the ceiling |
| `publish.vk.music-file`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_MUSIC_FILE`<br>`--publish-vk-music-file` | string, path | — | not available: vk has no API for attaching an audio file, so a value here is refused rather than ignored |
| `publish.vk.overlay`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_OVERLAY`<br>`--publish-vk-overlay` | list, path | — | template overlays applied for vk only, after the global ones |
| `publish.vk.owner-id`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_OWNER_ID`<br>`--publish-vk-owner-id` | int | — | wall the post lands on: negative for a community, such as -123456, positive for a user |
| `publish.vk.token`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_TOKEN`<br>`--publish-vk-token` | string | — | VK access token with the wall, photos, video and docs scopes **Secret**: redacted by `crier config`. |
| `publish.vk.width`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_VK_WIDTH`<br>`--publish-vk-width` | int | — | render width for vk; 0 inherits render.width |

A sample carrying every key with its default is at
[`crier.example.yaml`](../../../crier.example.yaml).
